description: Fill the agent's system knowledge from the code: its system prompts, tools and documentation, verbatim, become the sources QualiLoop reads and judges against, and General describes the agent. Give them inline, or as `file`, a JSON file in this workspace with the same fields (better for long prompts). The answer lists each source as new, unchanged or a new version, the ones retired, the ones a person keeps, and the General fields written or kept. Send it again after changing a prompt, a tool or a document. Set overwrite only when the user asked to replace General.

documentation.description: One entry per document in the repository the agent answers from, named by its path, verbatim.

file.description: A JSON file in this workspace with the body.

general.description: From the code and README only: the agent's name, a one-sentence summary, and a description of what it is, who uses it and what matters most.

overwrite.description: Write General over what is there. Only when the user explicitly asked; otherwise only empty fields are filled.

system_prompts.description: Every system prompt, verbatim; a template as written.

agent.description: The agent or subagent this prompt instructs, as the code names it.

name.description: Where it is in the code, such as a path and a variable.

placeholders.description: Every part filled at run time, exactly as it appears in the text.

tools.description: Every tool the agent can call, with its description and argument schema.

name: connect_save_agent_context
